name: Summit AZ - 7 Page Boost 2026-10-07
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-10-07

# Summary
Draft (Oct 7) to get seven rewritten pages indexed. URL Inspection showed 3 pages unknown to Google, 2 discovered but never crawled and 2 last crawled in July, before the Sep 25 rewrites. Content was already unique (under 20% overlap), so the fix was stronger crawl paths, then Request Indexing. The companion ops file `Summit-AZ-7-Page-Boost-Ops-2026-10-07.json` holds the machine edits.

# Target pages
- Garbage disposal Phoenix, water pressure Phoenix, water heater Phoenix, drain cleaning Queen Creek, drain cleaning Scottsdale, faucet and toilet, shower and bath.

# Changes
1. 13 new in-text links from indexed pages that already earn impressions (leak detection Phoenix, emergency Phoenix, Queen Creek and Scottsdale, /plumbing/, /plumbing-maintenance/, four blog posts), using the house underline style. Homepage untouched.
2. Water pressure Phoenix retargeted to "PRV replacement Phoenix" (480 / KD 19, approved by Kim): H1, subheading, intro, focus keyword, title, meta.
3. Drain Queen Creek and Scottsdale: question-style H2s and city-localized Related Services buttons.
4. Shower page: new 3-question FAQ with FAQPage schema; faucet page: FAQPage schema for its existing 3 Q&As; Service schema on both.
5. Request Indexing for all 7.

# Decisions and status
- All applied Oct 7 per the change log. Indexing confirmed requested for all 7 (Quota Exceeded on /plumbing/). On Oct 8 the 9 linking pages were also submitted for recrawl.
